title: When will humans get to Mars? –  B1 English Listening Test

seo.title: When will humans get to Mars? – B1 English Listening Test - Test-English
seo.description: Listening comprehension test for intermediate students (CEFR B1). Watch a video about space exploration and choose the correct answers.

parts:
B1 English Listening Test

Watch a video about Mars. For questions 1 to 7, choose the correct answer.

For more videos like this, go to The Economist
Questions

questions.prompt: What is similar between the Earth and Mars?
Humans have sent more space probes to Mars than to any other planet because ...

choices.html: we are convinced we will find life.
the presence of life is a possibility.
is working with NASA to send people to Mars.
will send humans to Mars within the next two decades.
wants to send humans to Mars in 2024.
can only be made once every nine months.
can only be made when the planets are aligned.
At present, taking humans to Mars is too expensive.
It's not possible to find life on Mars.
Some people will probably die trying to get to Mars.
